purpose: Track voluntary, lawful and independently reviewable protection projects without treating an honour certificate as money.
project_requirements: A real project owner and lawful funding source must be identified before any spending claim.
Record approved budget, actual disbursements, dates, vendors and outcome measures separately.
Receipts and payment evidence must be checked against the actual transaction; plans and generated files are not proof of spending.
Obtain informed consent where personal stories, images or testimonials are used; consent to aid must never be conditional on publicity.
Use safeguarding procedures for children and vulnerable people.

evidence_index.location_policy: Keep precise geolocation private; publish only coarse area data when safe, lawful and consented.
evidence_index.hash_note: SHA-256 supports integrity checking only; it does not independently verify that a claimed activity occurred.

continuation.next_honour_review: May be proposed only after a completed project review and a fresh human decision under the separate honour policy.
continuation.issue_authority: No authority is created by this file; any certificate remains symbolic and subject to separate consent, policy review and human approval.
continuation.do_not_count_as: income, sales, payment, legal tender, investment, guaranteed value, or proof of funds

public_ledger.corrections: Append a correction or superseding event; do not silently rewrite historical claims.

dashboard_counters.planned_projects: count separately from funded and active projects
dashboard_counters.beneficiaries_reached: count only with a defensible method and privacy safeguards
dashboard_counters.unresolved_reviews: show openly; never represent as verified

activation_gates: Named accountable project operator and lawful funding source
Evidence storage with access controls and retention policy
Independent reviewer authentication and conflict checks
Human approval before any public claim of verified protection
legal_boundary: This is a proposed evidence-tracking policy. It does not create funds, entitlements, a currency, a trust, a charity, a judicial body or a payment obligation.
